theorems.name: Submission.ted_lp_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → ∀ (y : Amb n ℓ) (R S Λ : ℝ), 0 < R → R < S → 0 < Λ → closedBall y S ⊆ U → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y S, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂V.weight < ⊤ → V.scaledLpNorm H p y R ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ) → ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R → Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ F r ∧ F r ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |F r - 1| ≤ Real.exp (Λ / 2) / 2 * Λ * (r / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p) ∧ (Λ ≤ 1 → |F r - 1| ≤ Λ * (r / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p))) ∧ ∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → r ≤ R → F s * ((V.weight (closedBall y s)).toReal / s ^ n) + (F s - 1) ≤ F r * ((V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal / r ^ n) + (F r - 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
